articles.title: SECOM Co Ltd's Dividend Analysis
articles.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. SECOM Co Ltd (SOMLF) recently announced a total dividend of $0.37 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-29. The distribution consists of a $0.37 per share cash dividend, with the payable date listed as 0000-00-00, which indicates that no confirmed payment date is available at this time.
